description: Science, causes, impacts, and solutions for human-caused climate change

the_science.greenhouse_effect: Gases in atmosphere trap heat; natural process that warms Earth by ~33°C
the_science.enhanced_greenhouse_effect: Human activities increase greenhouse gas concentrations, amplifying warming

greenhouse_gases.CO2: Carbon dioxide; 76% of GHG emissions; fossil fuels and deforestation; 420 ppm in 2024 (280 ppm pre-industrial)
greenhouse_gases.CH4: Methane; 16% of emissions; agriculture, landfills, natural gas; 80× more potent than CO₂ over 20 years
greenhouse_gases.N2O: Nitrous oxide; 6%; agriculture and industry; 265× more potent than CO₂
greenhouse_gases.F_gases: Fluorinated gases; 2%; industrial; very high warming potential

the_science.ipcc: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change; synthesizes climate science; reports since 1990

causes.fossil_fuels: 71% of global CO₂ emissions from burning coal, oil, natural gas
causes.deforestation: 11% of emissions; land-use change destroys carbon sinks
causes.agriculture: Livestock (methane from digestion and manure), rice paddies, synthetic fertilizers
causes.industry: Cement, steel, chemicals; difficult to decarbonize

temperature.1_5C: Likely by 2040s; limits most severe impacts

observed_effects: Sea level rise (~3.7 mm/year; 20 cm since 1900)
Arctic warming 3× faster than global average
Increased frequency of extreme weather events

tipping_points.ice_sheet_collapse: West Antarctic or Greenland collapse; meters of sea level rise
tipping_points.permafrost_thaw: Releases methane from Arctic soils; feedback loop
tipping_points.coral_bleaching: Mass die-off above 1.5°C for extended periods

goals: Limit warming to well below 2°C, preferably 1.5°C
paris_agreement.mechanism: Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs); updated every 5 years
paris_agreement.current_trajectory: NDCs put world on ~2.5–3°C warming path

mitigation.energy: Transition to renewable energy (solar, wind); phase out fossil fuels
mitigation.transport: Electric vehicles; public transit; active transport
mitigation.buildings: Better insulation; heat pumps; green construction
mitigation.land_use: Stop deforestation; restore forests; sustainable agriculture
mitigation.carbon_capture: CCS from industry; direct air capture; reforestation

carbon_pricing.carbon_tax: Fee per tonne of CO₂ emitted
carbon_pricing.current_coverage: 23% of global emissions covered by carbon pricing
